scalars.scalar_value: Minimum of 4 years broad based experience in the repair of complex medical instrumentation

items.item_text: Minimum of 4 years broad based experience in the repair of complex medical instrumentation

Independently perform complex troubleshooting and repairs on designated modality, with a 100% success rate of diagnosing a problem. Also independently perform installations, calibrations and preventive maintenance with no technical direction in that modality.

Performs preventative and corrective maintenance on basic laboratory instrumentation including, centrifuges, cell washers, pipettors, dilutors, photometers and other light-based devices, glassware washers, histology equipment, biological cabinets and fume hoods (ESI/PA only, no calibration), osmometers, refractometers, shakers, rotators, temperature-dependent equipment, sweat chloride collectors and microscopes (PA only).

Performs preventative and corrective maintenance on electronic devices which may emit coherent (low energy) electromagnetic radiation, such as; lasers and communication transmissions, as well as, electronic equipment which may emit infrasonic, sonic, and ultrasonic vibrations; to include: vibrators, oscillators, cauterizers, diagnostic and nondestructive equipment.
Inspects new and repaired biomedical equipment prior to issuance to meet DHS, JCAHO and other regulating bodies requirement.
Be able to read, analyze, interpret and follow signal flow on blue prints, schematics and wiring diagrams.
